pr_title: planner: Add explain info for ClusterLogTableExtractor
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/15379

Problem Summary:

UCP: Add explain info for ClusterLogTableExtractor
1. planner/core: memtable_predicate_extractor.go
2. *: Add explain info for ClusterLogTableExtractor


Here is an example I query it locally：

```sh
mysql> desc select * from information_schema.cluster_log where time >= '2019-12-23 16:10:13' and time <= '2019-12-23 16:30:13';
+----------------+----------+------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| id             | estRows  | task | operator info                                                                                                               |
+----------------+----------+------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| MemTableScan_5 | 10000.00 | root | table:CLUSTER_LOG, Start_time:2019-12-23 16:10:13, end_time:2019-12-23 16:30:13|
+----------------+----------+------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

- Unit test

Side effects

- No
